div.div:
Identity & semantics — every call
1. four headers — Sessionid · Tenantid ·
Tenantorgunitid · Username
2. envelope {code, status, data} — unwrap
3. not found = 500 + DH40002 → null
4. /execute always HTTP 200 — res_status is the signal
5. row cap client-side (1000) · timeout 120 s
6. heavy queries 30–50 s — tenant is shared production
